comments.body: If you want to farm PO4s... The business mediators in Zanzibar and Aden have many quests that offer PO4s as a reward. Zanzibars quests give 3 or 4 PO4s but you have to deliver the goods all the way to Europe (and since your carrying trade goods, you cant use Suez Canel to get there). Adens quests only requires you to deliver goods to nearby ports like Basra and Calicut, but gives only one PO4 for your work.

comments.author: Will_Adams
comments.body: *Sigh* Yet another sign of how sick this games economy has gotten: I'm seeing more and more "WTB PO4's(or PO1's) for 2m per" shouts in Seville lately. This means there are more and more players that have 10's or even 100's of billions of ducats(stashed on alts) that can afford to pay extra for what they want when they're in a hurry to get what they want. It's going to be the same thing as what happened with SSIP's. They were 10-12m per, then 12-15m per, then a few players with uber-rich characters that were in a hurry to get what they wanted started offering 20m per, which became the standard....for now anyway, lately Ive been seeing "WTB SSIP for 25m per" shouts. I can't help but wonder, how long will it be before that becomes the standard? And where does it end? How long will it be before we start seeing shouts in Seville of "WTB QMP for 2m per" or "WTB SSIP for 30m per"?

comments.author: Miles

Just like in real life :3
